$comment: Documents a DELIBERATE divergence (#1376): test-e2e-deploy.yml's NEXTJS_REF (the Next.js ref every compat cell tests) currently differs from packages/kn-next/templates/app/package.json.hbs's next pin (the Next.js version the scaffold actually ships). tests/nextjs-credential-lockstep.test.ts fails if either real value drifts from what THIS file documents, so a future bump to either side must update this manifest in the same PR — a reviewed decision, never silent drift.
divergenceReason: Founder decision 2026-09-27 (#1570, grilling Q12 option b): rc.1 is cut on the latest published Next 16.2.x tag at or above the CVE floor 16.2.11 (v16.2.12; v16.2.13 does not exist, verified via the GitHub tags API) as the RC1 REHEARSAL window for the credential-window machinery. The 16.3.5 credential moves to rc.2 (#1571): the four 16.3.5 dispatches (run 36332940411/36332946048/36332951393/36332959885, PR #1547) failed on five upstream tests added AFTER 16.2.x (cache-components-prerender-matrix, non-ascii-cache-item-name, not-found-non-document, expire-time, incremental-cache-path-traversal — none exist at v16.2.11, verified via the GitHub contents API) plus a knext-owned bytecode-liveness gate on the node cells; quarantining tests knext has never passed would not be an honest credential. The prior v16.2.0->16.3.5 investigation (re-INVESTIGATED 2026-09-27, PR #1545 reverted after tests/deploy-manifest.test.ts went red) is superseded by this rc.1/rc.2 split: v16.2.0 -> v16.2.12 is a same-minor-line bump (14 $knextQuarantines entries re-audited against fresh v16.2.12 compat-suite dispatch evidence, run ids on issue #1570), so the family-level and per-case quarantine mechanisms observed at v16.2.0 remain applicable pending that per-entry re-audit; the harder v16.2.x -> 16.3.5 minor-line jump (needing the five new upstream tests fixed or evidence-quarantined) is rc.2's job, not this bump's.

lockstepExceptions.reason: The vinext/bun single-executable compat lane (ADR-0048, #608) is a SEPARATE axis from the four node/bun x turbopack/webpack credential cells this manifest tracks — its own credentialing is v1.x scope (not rc.1), so it is deliberately left at the pre-#1570 ref rather than silently re-pinned by this bump. Re-credential it on its own schedule, not as a side effect of the rc.1 rehearsal.

Same as the dispatch-default exception above (compat-vinext.yml) — the vinext lane's NEXTJS_REF env fallback mirrors its own dispatch default and is out of scope for the rc.1 node/bun credential rehearsal (#1570).
